last_review.summary: The change is confined to src/authorization/, builds successfully, and implements a framework-neutral all-required scope evaluator using exact string matching. Empty requirements authorize, duplicate requirements are handled deterministically, denial exposes only missing scope names, and no role mappings, bypasses, client-supplied identity derivation, HTTP plumbing, or architectural violations were introduced.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
